name: Claude Code
note: Sessions are read from Claude's own live registry in ~/.claude/sessions, which reports status per pid — richer than any file map could express. What lives here is which processes count as Claude: the CLI, the copy inside Claude Desktop, and the SDK binary that ACP hosts like Zed launch. Miss one and its memory reads 0MB. Not declared, and deliberately: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. Looked into 2026-09-26 while five other harnesses gained source.relocate, and the evidence contradicts itself. Third-party tooling describes the variable as relocating the whole config directory; there are also open feature requests on Claude Code's own tracker asking for exactly that variable to be added, and an issue on a profile-switching tool titled to the effect that it is unsupported and that such tools manage a directory Claude Code does not read. Declaring it on that evidence would be worse than leaving it: a user who sets it on third-party advice would have this app look somewhere Claude Code does not write, and sessions that exist under ~/.claude would read as absent. One check against a version that honours it — or the variable appearing in Claude Code's own documentation — is the whole of what is missing.

compatibility.note: Native live-registry reader; validate against local data with --check.
